fields.name: Chicken and vegetable rice bowl
fields.description: A filling, high-protein meal made with chicken, rice and mixed vegetables.
fields.ingredients:
Chicken
Rice
Mixed Vegetables
Soy sauce
Seasoning
fields.cooking_method:
1. Cook the rice according to its packet instructions.

2. Cut the chicken into small pieces and prepare the vegetables.

3. Cook the chicken in a lightly oiled pan until completely cooked through.

4. Add the vegetables, soy sauce and seasoning, then cook until the vegetables are hot and tender.

5. Place the rice in a bowl, add the chicken and vegetables, and serve.

fields.name: Spiced chickpea wraps
fields.description: Quick vegetarian wraps containing chickpeas, salad and yoghurt.
fields.ingredients:
Chickpeas
Spices (cumin and paprika)
Mixed vegetables
Sauce (any)
fields.cooking_method:
1. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

2. Cook the chickpeas in a lightly oiled pan with the spices until hot and lightly crisp.

3. Wash and prepare the salad ingredients.

4. Warm the tortilla wraps according to their packet instructions.

5. Fill each wrap with chickpeas, salad and yoghurt, then fold and serve.

fields.name: Tuna tomato pasta
fields.description: An affordable pasta meal containing tuna, tomatoes and mixed herbs.
fields.ingredients:
Canned tuna
Tomatoes
Pasta
Olive oil
Seasoning
fields.cooking_method:
1. Cook the pasta according to its packet instructions.

2. Soften the chopped onion in a lightly oiled pan.

3. Add the chopped tomatoes and seasoning, then simmer for several minutes.

4. Drain the tuna and stir it into the tomato sauce until heated thoroughly.

5. Drain the pasta, combine it with the sauce and serve.

fields.name: Banana overnight oats
fields.description: A simple breakfast that can be prepared the night before.
fields.cooking_method:
1. Mash the banana in a bowl or reusable container.

2. Add the oats, milk and yoghurt.

3. Mix the ingredients thoroughly until combined.

4. Cover the container and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 6 hours.

5. Stir before eating and add a little more milk if required.

fields.name: Greek yoghurt fruit oats
fields.description: A quick breakfast containing oats, Greek yoghurt and fruit.
fields.ingredients:
Oats
Greek yoghurt
Banana
Frozen berries
Honey
fields.cooking_method:
1. Place the oats in a bowl or reusable container.

2. Add the Greek yoghurt and mix until evenly combined.

3. Wash and prepare the fruit, then add it to the oats.

4. Add a small amount of milk if a softer consistency is preferred.

5. Serve immediately or refrigerate until required.

fields.name: Lentil and tomato soup
fields.description: An affordable warming soup made with lentils, tomatoes and vegetables.
fields.ingredients:
Red lentils
Chopped tomatoes
Carrot
Onion
Vegetable stock
Mixed herbs
fields.cooking_method:
1. Soften the chopped onion and vegetables in a saucepan with a small amount of oil.

2. Add the lentils, chopped tomatoes, stock and seasoning.

3. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat.

4. Simmer for approximately 20 minutes until the lentils and vegetables are tender.

5. Blend if a smoother texture is preferred, then serve hot.

fields.name: Peanut tofu noodles
fields.description: A plant-based noodle meal with tofu, vegetables and peanut sauce.
fields.ingredients:
Noodles
Tofu
Mixed vegetables
Peanut butter
Soy sauce
Lime juice
fields.cooking_method:
1. Cook the noodles according to their packet instructions, then drain them.

2. Cut the tofu into cubes and cook it in a lightly oiled pan until golden.

3. Add the prepared vegetables and cook until slightly softened.

4. Mix the peanut butter with soy sauce and a small amount of warm water to make a sauce.

5. Add the noodles and sauce to the pan, stir thoroughly and heat before serving.

fields.name: Egg fried rice
fields.description: A quick rice dish containing eggs, vegetables and simple seasoning.
fields.ingredients:
Rice
Eggs
Frozen peas
Carrot
Soy sauce
Spring onion
fields.cooking_method:
1. Heat a small amount of oil in a frying pan.

2. Add the vegetables and cook until they begin to soften.

3. Push the vegetables to one side, add the beaten egg and stir until cooked.

4. Add the cooked rice and mix everything together thoroughly.

5. Season with soy sauce, heat until piping hot and serve immediately.

fields.name: Chicken fajita wrap
fields.description: A high-protein wrap containing seasoned chicken and vegetables.
fields.ingredients:
Chicken breast
Tortilla wrap
Mixed peppers
Onion
Lettuce
Fajita seasoning
fields.cooking_method:
1. Slice the chicken and vegetables into thin strips.

2. Cook the chicken in a lightly oiled pan until browned and completely cooked through.

3. Add the vegetables and fajita seasoning, then cook until the vegetables have softened.

4. Warm the tortilla wrap according to its packet instructions.

5. Add the chicken mixture to the wrap, fold it securely and serve.

fields.name: Bean chilli jacket potato
fields.description: A filling baked potato topped with an affordable mixed-bean chilli.
fields.ingredients:
Baking potato
Kidney beans
Black beans
Chopped tomatoes
Onion
Chilli powder
fields.cooking_method:
1. Pierce the potato with a fork and cook it until soft throughout.

2. Soften the onion and any other vegetables in a pan with a small amount of oil.

3. Add the beans, chopped tomatoes and chilli seasoning.

4. Simmer the bean chilli for 10–15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

5. Cut open the potato, spoon the chilli over it and serve.

fields.name: Turkey couscous bowl
fields.description: A quick high-protein bowl containing turkey, couscous and vegetables.
fields.ingredients:
Turkey mince
Couscous
Mixed vegetables
Vegetable stock
Paprika
Mixed herbs
fields.cooking_method:
1. Place the couscous in a bowl and cover it with the recommended amount of boiling water.

2. Cover the bowl and leave the couscous for 5 minutes.

3. Cook the turkey pieces in a lightly oiled pan until browned and completely cooked through.

4. Fluff the couscous with a fork and mix in the prepared vegetables and seasoning.

5. Place the turkey over the couscous and serve.

fields.name: Cottage cheese jacket potato
fields.description: A simple jacket potato topped with protein-rich cottage cheese.
fields.ingredients:
Baking potato
Cottage cheese
Sweetcorn
Spring onion
Black pepper
fields.cooking_method:
1. Pierce the potato several times with a fork.

2. Microwave for 8–10 minutes, turning halfway through, until soft throughout.

3. Carefully cut the potato open and fluff the inside with a fork.

4. Spoon the cottage cheese over the potato.

5. Add seasoning and any prepared salad or vegetables before serving.
